**悬停物品动画**
---
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/A2Nx9kxDeB) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-1bd96a?logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/user/cutebow)
--- 为物品悬停时添加一个小动画 可通过模组菜单访问设置，默认设置是我个人偏好的配置 适用于所有容器界面，如箱子、潜影盒、物品栏等 ---
**默认设置效果预览** ![默认设置效果](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/mPPc1NjY/images/34f9bca9b61f3b27ff52f16644c4a43e9c2b9eff.gif)
--- 本模组仅为动画效果，无需担心延迟问题。拾取物品、拖拽操作、快捷键使用等均不受影响，所有功能均即时响应，仅添加纯粹的视觉动画效果。 有任何疑问？ 需要帮助？ 想报告漏洞？ 希望为模组添加新功能？ 或者单纯想成为酷炫玩家？⭐ **欢迎加入我的Discord社区！** [![关注我！](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow%20me!-💕-pink?style=flat)](https://namemc.com/profile/cutebow) [![NameMC](https://img.shields.io/badge/namemc-cutebow-ffb6c1?style=flat&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white)](https://namemc.com/profile/cutebow)
